name: Imprisonment

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a statuette of the target worth 5,000+ GP

summary: Wis save or a creature is bound in a magical prison (burial, chains, hedged prison, minimus containment or slumber) until a condition you set is met.
text: A creature that succeeds is immune to your later castings. A bound creature doesn't age, eat or breathe, can't teleport and is hidden from divination; only Dispel Magic cast with a level 9 slot on the prison or statuette can end it early, and reusing the statuette frees the first prisoner.
